name: Orchestrator Extension for Hashicorp Vault
description: The Hashicorp Vault Orchestrator extension allows you to manage certificates in Hashicorp Vault KeyValue secrets engine and perform inventory on certificates stored in the PKI or Keyfactor secrets engines.

store_types.Name: Hashicorp Vault PKI
store_types.ClientMachineDescription: This can be any value to help uniquely identify the store.  It is not used by this integration.

Properties.Name: ServerUsername
Properties.Description: The base URI (and port) to the instance of Hashicorp Vault ex: https://localhost:8200

Properties.Name: ServerPassword
Properties.Description: Vault token that will be used by the Orchestrator integration for authenticating and performing operations in the Vault instance

Properties.Name: MountPoint
Properties.Description: This is the mount point of the instance of the PKI or Keyfactor secrets engine plugin.  If using enterprise namespaces: <namespace>/<mount point>

StorePassword.Description: Vault token that will be used for authenticating

store_types.Name: Hashicorp Vault Key-Value PEM
store_types.ClientMachineDescription: This can be any value to help uniquely identify the store.  It is not used by this integration.
store_types.StorePathDescription: This is the path after mount point where the certificates will be stored.

Properties.Name: ServerUsername

Properties.Name: SubfolderInventory
Properties.Description: Should certificates found in sub-paths be included when performing an inventory?

Properties.Name: IncludeCertChain
Properties.Description: Should the certificate chain be included when performing an enrollment?

Properties.Name: MountPoint
Properties.Description: The base mount point of the secrets engine.  If using Vault Namespaces, include the namespace; ie. <namespace>/<mount point>

store_types.StorePathDescription: This is the path to the secret containing the store.
